### Gujuri Alekha
**Data Scientist | Applied Machine Learning & Time Series Forecasting**

Welcome! I am an applied Data Scientist with 2+ years of hands-on experience in building machine learning pipelines, time-series forecasting engines, and production MLOps workflows.

Currently, I work as a **Data Scientist Associate at Trinity Mobility**, designing intelligent IoT pipelines, energy demand simulation engines, and smart municipal alert services.
